CTR Reload Edition is a native Windows version of Crash Team Racing (PS1, 1999) with support for custom tracks, built on ctr-native and the CTR-ModSDK decompilation. This is a pre-release for testing: expect bugs. It contains no game data - you need your own NTSC-U disc image (SCUS-94426). Download ctr_native.exe and alphamaker.exe into one folder; the game asks for the disc image on the first start.
